documents.text: , the board of directors hired Melvil Dewey , creator of the Dewey decimal system , to act as an adviser . Dewey recommended that the board buy the First Presbyterian Church , an edifice built in 1849 , and use it for approximately 10 years until permanent arrangements could be made . As it happened , this became the permanent arrangement . The Gothic architecture of the church proved quite suitable for a library . The library trustees hired Hannah Packard James to be the first head librarian and assigned her the task of organizing and preparing the library
